subject.title: [RFC] Multi-Agent Collaboration Enhancement: Capability Profiling + Shared Blackboard + Layered Memory + Token Cost Governance

question: Should #35203 remain a core roadmap umbrella, be narrowed to missing plugin/core APIs, or be split into separate RFCs for capability profiling, shared memory, and budget governance?
rationale: The requested stack crosses core runtime, plugin boundaries, storage, config, session privacy, and security policy, and current VISION.md supports the problem area only if the implementation avoids heavy default orchestration and keeps core lean.

options.title: Keep umbrella, split tracks
options.body: Keep #35203 open as the canonical design tracker and require separate scoped decisions/PRs for capability profiling, shared memory, and budget governance.

options.title: Move broad orchestration to plugins
options.body: Route blackboard/orchestration products to ClawHub or plugins, keeping only missing core APIs and security primitives in this repo.

options.title: Close as out of scope
options.body: Close the RFC if maintainers reject core shared-state and budget-governance work for the current roadmap.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella, split tracks
recommendation.body: Keep #35203 open as the canonical design tracker and require separate scoped decisions/PRs for capability profiling, shared memory, and budget governance.

likelyOwner.reason: They already provided adjacent scoping decisions on #65403 and #64435 and are the clearest product-direction owner in the available history.
